== Title ==
<span lang="ja">みすぼらしいナーフ飼い</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">ユーズド：「孤独なハン」、「戦士の勇気」、「知ってるさ」のいずれかをキャンセルする。ロスト：ハンとレイアが一緒に戦闘に参加している時に使う。運命数を2枚引く。合計値を、敵による損耗と合計戦闘力の値から引く（最低でも0より下には下がらない）。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">「でも、南の通路で俺たち二人きりだった所は見てないだろ。彼女は俺に本心を告げてくれたのさ」「な……この自惚れ屋で、気のきかない、みすぼらしいナーフ飼い！」</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Scruffy-Looking Nerf Herder.

'''Lore''' — But you didn't see us alone in the south passage. She told me her true feelings. Wha... you stuck-up, inconsiderate, scruffy-looking nerf herder!

'''Game text''' — USED: Cancel Solo Han, Warrior's Courage, or I Know. LOST: Use when Han and Leia are in a battle together. Draw two destiny. Subtract the total from opponent's attrition and total power. The values cannot fall below zero.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
USED names 「孤独なハン」, 「戦士の勇気」, and 「知ってるさ」 for Solo Han, Warrior's Courage, and I Know. LOST says 一緒に戦闘に参加している時に使う rather than “If Han and Leia are in a battle together”.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-D-scruffylookingnerfherder.gif|Original English face]], [[Scruffy-Looking Nerf Herder]].</ref>
